notes: Research article (Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 48 (2023) 21799-21813); no supplementary file in the input. H2 uptake measured gravimetrically (magnetic suspension/maglev balance, PSD-PH device) at -196 C, 1-50 bar, on KOH-activated corn-straw biochars CS-700-1 to CS-900-4; excess isotherms (Fig. 2F, Fig. 11) and absolute values converted from excess via Eq. (3) (Table 6, Fig. 2C); CS-900-4 also measured at 25 C, 50 bar (0.52 wt%, Fig. 12). BET areas for every measured sample in Table 4 (N2 at -196 C, BSD-PM analyzer). The text layer drops minus and degree signs ('196  C'); -196 C confirmed on page images main-01, main-04 and main-10. Carbon mass fraction of the activated product is not stated numerically (Table 1 gives the raw straw, 43.28 wt% C); the samples are treated as activated carbon on the paper's own description (carbon-based materials, Table 7 'carbon', Raman G and D bands). No retraction notice (record is_retracted false) and no statement that the uptake data were published before.
